@graph.name: Troponin testing within 3 hours of ED presentation

provenance.section_title: Critical Question 2: Troponin Testing Within 3 Hours of Presentation

rules.rationale: Troponin testing within 3 hours of ED presentation can be used to predict a low rate of 30-day MACE in adult patients with suspected NSTE ACS.
rules.citation: In adult patients with suspected acute [SNOMED: 272118002] NSTE ACS [SNOMED: 394659003], conventional [SNOMED: 255333006] troponin [SNOMED: 102680009] testing at 0 and 3 hours among low-risk ACS [SNOMED: 394659003] patients (defined by HEART [SNOMED: 80891009] score [SNOMED: 278061009] 0 to 3) can predict an acceptable low rate of 30-day MACE.

@graph.name: Nonischemic ECG

provenance.section_title: Critical Question 2: Troponin Testing Within 3 Hours of Presentation

rules.rationale: A nonischemic ECG result is one component of the validated accelerated diagnostic protocols (ADPs), combined with negative serial high-sensitivity troponin testing, used to predict a low rate of 30-day MACE and enable accelerated ED discharge.
rules.citation: In adult patients with suspected acute NSTE ACS who are determined to be low risk based on validated ADPs that include a nonischemic ECG result and negative serial high-sensitivity troponin testing results both at presentation and at 2 hours can predict a low rate of 30-day MACE allowing for an accelerated discharge pathway from the ED.
rules.citation_verbatim_excerpt: In adult patients with suspected acute NSTE ACS who are determined to be low risk based on validated ADPs that include a nonischemic ECG result and negative serial high-sensitivity troponin testing results both at presentation and at 2 hours can predict a low rate of 30-day MACE allowing for an accelerated discharge pathway from the ED.

rules.rationale: A single high-sensitivity troponin below the limit of detection (<5 ng/L) combined with a nonischemic ECG achieved 98%-99.8% negative predictive value for 30-day MACE/MI.
rules.citation: A single high-sensitivity troponin below the limit of detection (<5 ng/L) combined with nonischemic ECG achieved 98%-99.8% NPV for 30-day MACE/MI.
rules.citation_verbatim_excerpt: A single high-sensitivity troponin below the limit of detection (<5 ng/L) combined with nonischemic ECG achieved 98%-99.8% NPV for 30-day MACE/MI.
